maddeler.e:
استوجبت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْجَبْتُ (istawjabtu) /is.taw.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اِسْتَوْجَبْتَ (istawjabta) /is.taw.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اِسْتَوْجَبْتِ (istawjabti) /is.taw.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اِسْتَوْجَبَتْ (istawjabat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
